items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: The interviewee describes the context as a minstrel show they performed in, but the mention of 'Alexander' is made by the interviewer as a quote from a song/character ('Alexander, I'll hear you say you're going away... That's what Miss Boots was playing with'). The interviewee does not claim a perso

ctx.x: Let's bother Miss Boots for a while now. Huh? Let's bother Miss Boots for a while now.

Miss Boots, she's a little girl. She'd be on stage singing. Alexander, I'll hear you say you're going away. I'm coming back someday. Sorry to tell you, Alexander. That's what Miss Boots was playing with.
That was a minstrel show we used to have. They called them minstrel shows then, you know. So I used to try to be an actress there. Mm-hmm.
